name: CA-01
label: Safe D

key_factors: Polymarket prices the Democrat at about 95%
Mike McGuire has outraised incumbent James Gallagher with outside support
Gallagher's incumbency is the main Republican offset
model.rationale: The redrawn CA-01 clearly favors Democrats, and McGuire's fundraising edge plus market pricing near 95% reinforce that lean. Gallagher's incumbency keeps some Republican floor, but nothing in the evidence suggests a genuine tossup.
model.watch: Any general-election polling showing Gallagher running close to the new district's partisan lean would warrant moving this back toward Likely D.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; fundamentals point clearly one way (post-redistricting), so it is treated as safe for that party.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
California's 1st District was redrawn after the 2021 cycle to lean Democratic, with a partisan lean of about D+7, and no general-election polls are available for this race. Republican incumbent James Gallagher, who won the old configuration, faces Democratic state Senator Mike McGuire in the November general.

McGuire has raised more money than Gallagher, about $1.8 million to $1.5 million, and benefits from roughly $620,000 in outside support. Prediction markets price the Democratic side at about 95%, and the fundamentals of the new district point clearly toward the Democrat, with Gallagher's incumbency the main factor keeping the race from being a total blowout.
